environment_setting: Country B, City X, near a small regional airport where citizens often gather to watch planes take off and land.
norm_base: Citizens Knowingly interfering with aircraft operation posing imminent safety hazard Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: capture unique aerial footage of aircraft

legitimate.legitimate_action: Flying the drone in designated areas far from the airport
legitimate.benefits: Captures aerial footage legally and safely, avoids penalties
legitimate.costs: Limited access to interesting shots near the airport

illegal.illegal_action: Flying the drone near the airport, interfering with aircraft operation
illegal.benefits: Captures unique and thrilling footage of aircraft up close
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year, potential confiscation of drone

legitimate.legitimate_action: Confronting Alex and stopping him from flying the drone near the airport
legitimate.benefits: Prevents potential safety hazards, fulfills job responsibilities
legitimate.costs: Possible conflict with Alex, time spent on confrontation

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring Alex's drone activity near the airport
illegal.benefits: Avoids confrontation, saves time and effort
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face disciplinary action or job loss

legitimate.legitimate_action: Reporting Alex's drone activity to air traffic control
legitimate.benefits: Ensures safety of the aircraft and passengers
legitimate.costs: Delays in flight schedule, additional stress

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring Alex's drone activity and proceeding with the flight
illegal.benefits: Avoids delays and maintains flight schedule
illegal.costs: If an incident occurs, could face legal and professional consequences
